subject: Biotechnology
title: Biosecurity
description: A short lesson to help you apply Biosecurity.

hook.text: Synthetic biology can create new vaccines — but also potential pathogens. Biosecurity guards against misuse.

buildup.text: DNA synthesis companies screen orders against pathogen databases — flagging sequences from dangerous organisms.

discovery.text: The Australia Group coordinates export controls on dual-use biological equipment across 43 countries.

twist.text: Benchtop DNA synthesizers bypass screening — as synthesis becomes decentralized, oversight becomes harder.

climax.text: Responsible innovation frameworks balance openness with safety — the synbio community self-regulates proactively.

punchline.text: Power demands responsibility — biosecurity protects synbio's promise.

quiz.question: Why are benchtop DNA synthesizers a biosecurity concern?
options: They are too expensive for most researchers to afford
They can synthesize DNA without the screening that commercial companies perform
They produce DNA of lower quality that is dangerous to handle
